def fn(t0, t1, t2, k, lst, dct):
    v1 = t1.clone()
    v2 = torch.cat([t1, v1], 0)
    t1[-4] = v1[2]
    v3 = v2.reshape(v2.shape)
    v4 = v2.permute(2, 1, 0)
    v5 = v1.reshape((2, 12))
    idx6 = torch.tensor([1, 0], device=v1.device)
    v1.index_add_(2, idx6, t1.narrow(2, 0, 2))
    return (v3, v2, v1, lst, dct)
